title: Transalpine
summary: TRANSAL'PINE, adjective [Latin trans, beyond, and Alpine, of the Alps.] Lying or being beyond the Alps in regard to Rome, that is, on the north or west of the Alps; as transalpine Gaul; opposed to Cis

inlines.v: TRANSAL'PINE, adjective [Latin trans, beyond, and Alpine, of the Alps.] Lying or being beyond the Alps in regard to Rome, that is, on the north or west of the Alps; as transalpine Gaul; opposed to Cisalpine.
